I am an old woman, 57 years, with no schooling. This small plot of 0.21 hectare I will plant with what we always plant here in Tigray for the household — I have no money to buy much fertilizer this season, and the cooperative fertilizer came late again last year. I will spread some manure from my animals because that costs nothing, and I will use the seed I kept from last harvest. The rains here are not reliable, but I have no irrigation, so I will pray for good meher rains and weed the plot myself with help from my daughter.
